paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between IDK error rate and IDK recall for four different parameter combinations. The x-axis is labeled "IDK error rate," featuring a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.02 to 0.25, with numeric tick labels positioned at regular intervals of 0.05. The y-axis is labeled "IDK recall," utilizing a linear scale that covers a range from slightly below 0.1 to roughly 0.67, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines, each with numerical annotations positioned near its individual data points. The line labeled "No $\mathcal{L}_{\text{FP-reg}}$, fixed $\lambda$" is a solid blue line with 'x' markers; it demonstrates an upward trend, beginning at roughly x=0.02, y=0.09 (annotated 0.1), passing through intermediate points at approximately x=0.05, y=0.25 (annotated 0.2), x=0.09, y=0.39 (annotated 0.3), and x=0.15, y=0.55 (annotated 0.4), before ending at an x-value of 0.25 and a y-value of 0.67 (annotated 0.5). The "With $\mathcal{L}_{\text{FP-reg}}$, fixed $\lambda$" condition is represented by a solid orange line with 'x' markers, which also increases steadily from a starting position near x=0.02, y=0.12 (annotated 0.1) through points at roughly x=0.04, y=0.24 (annotated 0.2), x=0.06, y=0.35 (annotated 0.3), and x=0.10, y=0.49 (annotated 0.4), concluding at approximately x=0.17, y=0.60 (annotated 0.5). The "No $\mathcal{L}_{\text{FP-reg}}$, adaptive $\lambda$" configuration is depicted as a dashed green line with upward-pointing triangle markers, rising from an initial point near x=0.05, y=0.26 (annotated 0.2) to an endpoint at approximately x=0.20, y=0.64 (annotated 0.5). Finally, the "With $\mathcal{L}_{\text{FP-reg}}$, adaptive $\lambda$" condition is shown as a dashed red line with upward-pointing triangle markers, ascending from a starting position of roughly x=0.02, y=0.24 (annotated 0.2) to finish at approximately x=0.08, y=0.63 (annotated 0.5).
